Day 3: March 31, departure back to Manchester? Or maybe just the day includes travel back? The request says heading to Charlotte from March 29 to March 31. Likely they stay in Charlotte until March 31, then depart back. So day 3 travel back. Breakfast maybe at hotel. Attractions maybe "Levine Museum of the New South, Charlotte". Lunch maybe at airport. Then flight back. Accommodation maybe none or "In-flight". But need a field; can put "-" for accommodation.

We need to ensure budget $4800. Approx cost: flight round-trip for 5 ~ $1200 each = $6000, but budget is $4800. Maybe we choose economy flights $800 each = $4000, plus accommodation $200 per night per suite (2 suites) for 2 nights = $800, total $4800. Good.

We'll include note: flight cost within budget.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"
